nodes.description: Kearns-Sayre syndrome is caused by a single large-scale deletion of mitochondrial DNA, usually sporadic and heteroplasmic. Deleted genomes are detected in affected tissues such as skeletal muscle; the proportion of deleted mtDNA, rather than a nuclear-gene defect, determines whether high-energy post-mitotic tissues cross the bioenergetic threshold.
